title: Ex-Met Police inspector lied about wife's death in Barbados hotel room, BBC learns
content: Warren Arter faced claims of sexually exploiting crime victims - his wife was found in a blood-stained room.

title: Alleged Russell Brand rape victim wants age of consent law changed
content: Mia Latter, who says she was 16 when she met the convicted rapist, wants a staggered age of consent.

title: Watch: SpaceX catches part of its Starship rocket on return to Earth
content: SpaceX has performed the historic catch using mechanical arms nicknamed "chopsticks".

title: Hannah Fry feels 'unbelievably lucky' after cervical cancer treatment
content: The presenter says she has received a 'five-year clear' after having a hysterectomy in her thirties.

title: Israel kills Hamas commander in strike on Gaza camp, officials say
content: Both Hamas and IDF officials confirm the death of Samir Abu Younis, commander of the Rafah Brigade.

title: Judo champion shakes up French  presidential race with surprise candidacy
content: Teddy Riner is one of the most popular figures in modern-day France, and one in five voters say they could support him.
